title: Default transform_input to ('X_val',) in Pipeline and make_pipeline
answers: Why is X_val not being transformed in Pipeline fit?
How to automatically transform validation data in a scikit-learn Pipeline?
What is the default transform_input in Pipeline and make_pipeline?
Why does Pipeline fit accept transform_input without metadata routing enabled?
body:
Symptom: Validation set X_val passed to Pipeline.fit is not transformed by pipeline transformers before reaching estimators consuming it.
Root cause: sklearn/pipeline.py:Pipeline.__init__ defaulted transform_input to None, requiring manual configuration to transform validation metadata.
Fix pattern: Default metadata parameters that should be transformed to a tuple such as ("X_val",), allow tuple in parameter constraints, and exempt the default value from routing checks in sklearn/pipeline.py:Pipeline.fit.
Constraints: Applies to Pipeline and make_pipeline; custom transform_input requires enable_metadata_routing=True, while passing X_val without routing enabled raises a metadata routing ValueError.
applies: Pipeline and make_pipeline handling of transform_input and X_val validation data
